data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'glēow' meaning 'valley' or 'hollow' and 'dūn' meaning 'hill'. The name Glendon symbolizes a strong and courageous individual who overcomes obstacles and rises above challenges. The name Glendon carries the meaning “Valiant hill” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Glendon usually hope their child will grow to embody valiant hill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
